name: text
title: Text
description: Body copy, captions and inline text on the type scale, plus Prose for long rich text.

when: Any run of app text: descriptions, help text, captions, numbers.
Prose: long formatted content such as articles or terms.

instead.when: The words title a page or section.

guidance.rule: Keep legal and body text at `body` or larger; use `subtle` and `subtlest` tones for secondary text only.

builtIn: Tones meet WCAG AA contrast on every surface token.
youProvide: `elementType="p"` for paragraphs so the text has the right semantics.

genui.description: A run of body text. Use `tone` for meaning (danger, success…) and `subtle` for secondary text.
